text:
July 2026 is thinner than May or June and should read that way. There is no new GitHub folder and no Supported harness. The month is four public threads on X, plus a scoreboard. Topic write-ups already live on Recoverability geometry and Emergent gravity. This page is the calendar, so a scan of July does not look empty next to May.

The GitHub-first ingest never opened these threads because they have no Tmp/TOE folder. The previous wiki compile parked them on Recoverability geometry. Same ingest rule as May: replies with equations are first-class; a result does not need a new folder name to exist.

19 Jul — gravity is not waiting to be quantized

The interpretive sentence that later September restates is frozen here first. Gravity is not treated as a force among forces. It is treated as what a recoverability structure has to do so informational sources belong to one jointly recoverable reality. That is a gloss, not a derivation.

Gravity is not a fundamental interaction waiting to be quantized. It is an emergent phenomenon that appears when informational sources deform the recoverability structure of a timeless information layer — before time, entropy, or classical geometry exist.

19 Jul gravity-as-reorganization sentence. Interpretive freeze. Not a GEM-bridge closure and not Einstein dynamics.

20 Jul — A_G is a support poset, not a unique history

The admissible body A_G names which collections are allowed. Membership is not a ranking. Provenance only forces a support-poset by inclusion — one collection can be strictly more pruned than another. A law that would pick a unique path through A_G is still open. That is the next theorem named that day, not a result.

Provenance gives a canonical support-poset, but a unique pruning sequence is still open.

A same-day reply posed the working hypothesis for later pruning: at the relative boundary of A_G no full-rank global extension exists, and a universal forbidden support sector is shared by every compatible extension. Precursor of physical gravity remains open — not a theorem.

Whether provenance constraints induce a monotone chain of minimal faces, or several inequivalent support-loss orders remain compatible with the same A_G data. Unique pruning law through A_G is still Open.

23 Jul — the source-generator gate

An 11-part original, not a GitHub folder. Admissibility plus BKM reciprocity give response maps, not a universal source line. Edge operators K_{i|j} generally pick different leading source lines. A common generator K_{i|j}=f_{ij}(Q_i) would align them. The load-bearing gate: does global quantum provenance canonically generate Q_i?

K_{i|j}=f_{ij}(Q_i)\qquad\text{does global quantum provenance canonically generate }Q_i?

The frontier has narrowed from “Can gravity emerge?” to one exact mathematical gate: does global quantum provenance canonically generate Q_i?

Global provenance therefore does not canonically force a shared generator Q_i; an extra protecting law or symmetry appears required to close that gate.

Whether Genesis / provenance can force a shared source generator Q_i. In-thread review: not from admissibility + BKM reciprocity alone. Gravity still not claimed.

25 Jul — reciprocity is not focusing

A 20-part report answered the narrower question that is actually closed. Derived: A_G is compact and convex; a bipartite state does not canonically determine a Hilbert-fiber map; each edge defines an intrinsic BKM response with exact adjoint reciprocity; a common aggregate mode is not universal edgewise coupling. Reciprocity does not imply attraction. A sufficient focusing law is cone positivity / MTP₂ on increasing observables.

C_{ji}=C_{ij}^{\sharp}\qquad\text{but}\qquad \text{reciprocity}\not\Rightarrow\text{focusing sign}

\mathcal A_G^+\subsetneq \mathcal A_G\cap\prod_{e\in E}\mathrm{MTP}_2^{(e)}

Trees: local focusing glues globally. Cycles: global focusing frustration can occur.

The triangle counterexample is an exact finite calculation: pair-marginals that are each strictly associated, yet no globally MTP₂ completion exists. A noisy square at ε=10⁻³ has numerical evidence of the same obstruction (best conditional minor ≈ −5.74×10⁻⁷) — not yet an SOS certificate. Physical gravity is not claimed.

Exact triangle MTP₂ focusing-frustration, and tree local-to-global MTP₂ closure, inside a finite classical commuting sector. Physical gravity not claimed. Square infeasibility remains numerical.

25 Jul — GEM / GR scoreboard, not a derivation

The same day posted an editorial scoreboard: GEM marked present for geometry / cosmology / quantum columns; GR and Einstein-like remain open. A one-line restatement in the thread: gravity is not treated as a force among forces. A fun Einstein-wave animation in the same thread is not load-bearing.

July 2026 GEM / GR scoreboard. Editorial comparison. GEM marked present in three columns; GR and Einstein-like remain open. Not a derivation.

25 Jul Einstein-wave animation. Media follow-up, not a result.

What this still is not

Not a unique pruning law through A_G. The poset is named; the law is Open.
Not a construction of Q_i from admissibility + reciprocity. In-thread review says those ingredients are not enough.
Not physical gravity, GEM-bridge closure, or Einstein dynamics. The 19 Jul sentence is a gloss.
Not a May-density month. No new Tmp/TOE folder. Codazzi and W-state are August. Astra is September.
Not every July reply. Day-job, vendor, and other people’s theories stay on X.
